Story: Eagle Feather is the daughter of the tribal chief and has grown up immersed in the ways of war and leadership. She is a natural commander, renowned for her prowess on horseback and her ability to devise clever strategies. Her courage and charisma inspire loyalty and bravery in her fellow warriors, making her a vital part of the warband.
